parameters.name: spec:voxel
parameters.what: grid size in head-local units (.0025 is .00067 figure heights, finer than the .0008 the method asks for)

parameters.name: spec:strip.u
parameters.what: |u| from which the old front coat is stripped: above y .045, and below it (figure heights)

parameters.name: spec:strip.yBlend
parameters.what: rows over which strip.u switches

parameters.name: spec:strip.ramp
parameters.what: width of the strip edge in u

parameters.name: spec:strip.rampIn
parameters.what: width of the strip edge toward the skull (a slope, not a wall)

parameters.name: spec:strip.bottom
parameters.what: no strip below this row

parameters.name: spec:strip.maxDepth
parameters.what: the cut sinks at most this far behind the old front face

parameters.name: spec:strip.depthRamp
parameters.what: the cut sinks from the old front to the backing over this much

parameters.name: spec:strip.midBlur
parameters.what: box blur of the old mid-surface

parameters.name: spec:backing.shift
parameters.what: the backing front is at least this far behind the old mid-surface

parameters.name: spec:backing.depthBehindDeepest
parameters.what: the backing front lies this far behind the deepest layer rear faces (spec .015 does not fit the thin fan)

parameters.name: spec:backing.minThickness
parameters.what: never closer than this to the old rear face

parameters.name: spec:backing.blur
parameters.what: smoothing of the backing surface

parameters.name: spec:layers.0.standoff
parameters.what: layer 1 (S, D) is set back this far toward the tips, so each primary tip stands clear of the secondary beneath

parameters.name: spec:layers.0.undercut
parameters.what: back half width as a fraction of the front (below 1 tucks the back under)

parameters.name: spec:layers.1.undercut
parameters.what: same for layer 2

parameters.name: spec:layers.1.shingle
parameters.what: every second primary lies this far behind its neighbours so each flank stands as an edge

parameters.name: spec:section.p
parameters.what: superellipse exponent of the section

parameters.name: spec:section.spine
parameters.what: extra front height along the center line, fraction of the half thickness

parameters.name: spec:section.rollDeg
parameters.what: constant lean about the axis, alternating sign lock to lock

parameters.name: spec:section.twistDeg
parameters.what: peak twist about the axis, deterministic sign per lock

parameters.name: spec:section.widthScale
parameters.what: width of every coat lock against the table

parameters.name: spec:section.thickScale
parameters.what: thickness of every coat lock against the table

parameters.name: spec:section.camber
parameters.what: forward camber of the front face at mid length

parameters.name: spec:section.lowerScale
parameters.what: width and thickness scale of the small lower locks

parameters.name: spec:section.rings
parameters.what: rings along a lock

parameters.name: spec:section.around
parameters.what: points around a ring

parameters.name: spec:tips.minHalfWidth
parameters.what: half width of the last ring (figure heights); at least 2 voxels

parameters.name: spec:tips.minHalfThick
parameters.what: half thickness of the last ring

parameters.name: spec:tips.length
parameters.what: the apex vertex stands this far past the last ring

parameters.name: spec:tips.taperScale
parameters.what: multiplies the table taper exponents

parameters.name: spec:union.rootBand
parameters.what: smooth union only within this distance of a lock root

parameters.name: spec:union.rootRamp
parameters.what: fade of the root band

parameters.name: spec:union.rootBlend
parameters.what: smooth union radius in the root band

parameters.name: spec:union.rootCap
parameters.what: a lock is carried this far behind its root, into the head

parameters.name: spec:union.stemRadius
parameters.what: radius of the rod from a coat lock root back into the backing, as a fraction of the root half width (what joins a lock whose root side the cup carve removes)

parameters.name: spec:union.stemInto
parameters.what: the stem ends this far inside the backing (figure heights)

parameters.name: spec:union.rearMargin
parameters.what: thickness clamp keeps the lock back this far in front of the old rear face

parameters.name: spec:union.rearClip
parameters.what: new material is cut off this far behind the old rear face

parameters.name: spec:union.seamBlur
parameters.what: box blur radius (voxels) in the strip-edge and cup-rim seam bands

parameters.name: spec:tuft.standoff
parameters.what: a tuft tip stands this far in front of the floor

parameters.name: spec:tuft.widthScale
parameters.what: tuft clump width scale

parameters.name: spec:tuft.thickScale
parameters.what: tuft clump thickness scale

parameters.name: spec:tuft.rootBand
parameters.what: tuft clumps merge within this distance of their roots

parameters.name: spec:tuft.rootBlend
parameters.what: smooth union radius of the merged root

parameters.name: spec:pale.tol
parameters.what: faces within this distance of a tuft solid get the pale material

parameters.name: spec:cup.yawDeg
parameters.what: the opening yaw outward from straight forward (floor slope tan of it)

parameters.name: spec:cup.floorStart
parameters.what: floor depth at u .100

parameters.name: spec:cup.floorMax
parameters.what: deepest floor

parameters.name: spec:cup.bowl
parameters.what: extra depth toward the middle of the polygon

parameters.name: spec:cup.dish
parameters.what: carve depth rises to the coat surface over this much inside the rim

parameters.name: spec:cup.fillet
parameters.what: rim fillet radius

parameters.name: spec:clumps
parameters.what: per-clump table edits by name or fnmatch pattern (the shipped spec re-fans the tuft rows)

notes: Method as in methods.md R03 (layered lock sweeps), built as: each lock is a closed triangle mesh (numpy: Bezier guide from the clump table, superellipse section p 2.4 with a raised spine and a narrower back, width and thickness tapering to an apex vertex, twist and alternating lean), voxelized with OpenVDB createLevelSetFromPolygons at the head grid (voxel .0025 head-local = .00067 figure heights, finer than the .0008 asked) and unioned with a hard minimum, so locks keep their own creases; a smooth union of .004 only within .035 of the lock root; a stem rod from each coat root back into the backing joins locks whose root side the cup carve removes (without it LS7 and RS8 floated and were deleted as islands). Layer 1 (S, D) is set back .014 toward its tips behind layer 2 (P); every second P lies .012 behind its neighbours; the backing is the old fan stripped (the v2 strip with its ramps, so no cut wall) down to .014 behind the deepest layer's rear faces, at least .006 behind the old mid-surface and .010 in front of the old rear face (the spec's .015 does not fit the .09 deep fan). There is no envelope core. The cup is a bowl (polygon, yawed floor tan(35 degrees), concave bowl, dish at the rim, fillet) carved before the tuft goes in; the tuft rows of the table are re-fanned in the spec (roots clustered at the skull line y .118 to .146, tips spread up and out) because the table's parallel rows read as a stack of horizontal rods (the venetian blind of round 21). Departures from the specs/R03.md numbers, all levers: width x .9, thickness x .8, spine .45, p 2.4, lean 14 degrees, tip half width .003 (assembly remesh), the tuft re-fan, tuft width x 1.2 and thickness x 1.5, pale tolerance .004. Reused: the table, envelope, strip, cup floor and polygon helpers and mesh cleaning of the earlier tool (fan_clumps_front_fast_v2.py, fan_clumps_fast_common.py), the R03 zones file, loop/render_head_clay.py for the images. Not done: the exact mesh boolean option (the level-set union is used); tip standoff measured on the voxel fields (tipClearance is a column check and its median is -.004, so the secondaries are not fully clear of the primaries where the old rear face stops them sinking); tips thinner than .003 (the assembly remesh removes them).
debug: --debug-owner paints faces within a voxel of a layer 1 solid and a layer 2 solid in two grays (materials 1 and 2); --export-locks writes every solid as its own object; sections.npz holds four constant-height slices of each wing field. Run through loop_tools.py blender with the flags directly after the script name (no leading --). A Python syntax error does not print Traceback, so check that the output directory has head.blend.
